title: Scaling DGK-alpha Drug Discovery through GPU-Accelerated Virtual Screening and Ensemble Molecular Dynamics
summary: Uses fast computer screening to find drug candidates against a protein that helps glioblastoma, a deadly brain cancer, grow and hide from the immune system.

title: Drugging the “Hard Problem” with General Anesthetics
summary: Uses anesthesia drugs, which switch consciousness off and back on, to study how the brain creates conscious experience.

title: Pilot screening of structure-guided small-molecule inhibitors targeting filovirus nucleocapsid assembly
summary: Screens new drug candidates that could stop Ebola and Marburg viruses from assembling inside our cells.

title: Restoring Mitochondrial Fitness to Enhance Antiviral Immunity in Treated HIV Infection: A Host-Directed Therapeutic Strategy
summary: Tests whether restoring cells' energy factories can strengthen immunity in people living with HIV.

title: Two-Color-Gated Optogenetics: Working Towards Full Spatiotemporal Control of Gene Expression in 3D Cellular Architectures
summary: Builds a light-controlled switch that turns genes on only where two beams of light cross, for precise control in 3D tissue.
